# Near Bakery & Co. — Web Store
> Artisan Bakery Premium — Roti sourdough, croissant, pastry & kue segar panggang setiap hari.

## Store Info
- Name: Near Bakery & Co.
- URL: https://storebakery.web.app
- Type: Artisan Bakery E-Commerce
- Language: id (Indonesian)
- Location: Indonesia

## Features
- Online ordering with pre-order (made-to-order) system
- Payment: Bank Transfer (BCA), E-Wallet (GoPay/OVO), COD
- Live chat with admin
- Multi-branch support
- Made-to-order fresh daily production

## Product Categories
- Roti & Sourdough
- Viennoiserie & Croissant
- Kue & Tart
- Kue Kering & Cookies
- Minuman Kopi & Teh
